At a domain: at related arguments.
        intros k u u' pre pre' Ts B' t' B t v v' rs rs' Hf IH Fr Fr' Ha.
        inversion Ha as [| ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? Hfa]; subst.
        constructor; [| exact Fr | exact Fr' ]; intros c0 c0' Hc0; exact (IH c0 c0' Hc0 (Hfa c0 c0' Hc0)).
      - intros k u u' pre pre' Ts t' t v c v' c' rs rs' fc fc' rcs rcs' Ef Ef' F1 F2 Hcr IH Ha.
        inversion Ha; subst.
        match goal with Er : $| v & c | gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ ?r, Er' : $| v' & c' | gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ ?r',
                        Ha' : rec_arg_rel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ?r ?r' |- _ =>
          pose proof (functional_eval_app _ _ _ _ Er Ef) as ->; pose proof (functional_eval_app _ _ _ _ Er' Ef') as ->;
          econstructor; [ exact Ef | exact Ef' | exact F1 | exact F2 | exact (IH Ha') ]
        end.
      - intros; constructor.
      - intros * Hcf IH Ha; inversion Ha; subst; constructor; apply IH; assumption.
      - intros * Ers Hcf IH Ha; inversion Ha; subst; econstructor; [ exact Ers | apply IH; assumption ].
      - intros * L1 L2 Hcr IHr Hcf IHf Ha; inversion Ha; subst.
        constructor; [ exact L1 | exact L2 | apply IHr; assumption | apply IHf; assumption ].
    Qed.
  End Merge.

The Wrapped Branch's Context at Related Arguments

Arguments of two constructors of the view's member v, related canonically, the container's results w on the left, merged into the group's (merge_ihs), related to the group's results ihs' on the right: related at the recursive results of the wrapped branch's context, the group's at the paths the container has (sel_ihs). Each entry is the type of the group's result along its path, whose relation is the result's (leaf_walk_sem).
  Section WrapCv.
    Variable (D' : ind_decl).
    Variable (v : nat) (Mv : imember) (c : String.string) (gs' gs : list carg).
    Hypotheses (HMv : ind_member D v = Some Mv) (Hcon : ind_con Mv c = Some gs) (Hk : cargs_same_kinds gs' gs)
      (HrvMv : im_is_rview Mv = false).
    Let nn := im_nn Mv.
    Let na := List.length gs.
    Let T := List.rev (im_nparams Mv).
    Let As := blocks_motives Bks.
    Let τU := sb_of_list Id Us.
    Let Cs := tele_sub (cargs_ctx p D Mv gs) (sb_qn nn τU).
    Let Ns := tele_sub (im_nparams Mv) τU.
    Let HB := valid_blocks_bctx _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk _ _ _ _ HMv Hcon.
    #[local] Abbreviation WB f := (f VP p D HP HPD Γ Us Bks iA HΓ HUl HUs HUss HBss HBk D' v Mv c gs' gs HMv HrvMv Hcon Hk).
    Let TB := List.rev (Cs ++ Ns).
    #[local] Abbreviation EBr f := (EM f v Mv c gs HMv Hcon HB HrvMv).

    Lemma canonical_wrap_ihs : forall B1 B2, RΓ B1 C1 -> RΓ B2 C1 ->
        forall X X' vs vs' ihsM w ihs',
        tele_rel (nr v) T X X' ->
        tele_rel (ar v X c) (cargs_nonrec gs) (nonrec_arg_vals gs vs) (nonrec_arg_vals gs vs') ->
        con_args_rel p D (admissible_index_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr v u0 u0 X X' T gs vs vs' ->
        rec_results_rel D dr Rel v u0 u0 X X' T gs vs vs' (merge_ihs D' D gs' gs ihsM w) ihs' ->
        List.length ihsM = cargs_nrec D gs -> List.length w = cargs_container_count D D' gs' gs ->
        per_tele_args TB B1 B2 (X ++ vs) (X' ++ vs') ->
        forall kk, kk <= na ->
        per_tele_args (List.rev (wrap_ihs_ctx D D' nn As Us na nil 0 (List.firstn kk gs') (List.firstn kk gs)))
          (env_tele B1 TB (X ++ vs)) (env_tele B2 TB (X' ++ vs'))
          (List.firstn (cargs_container_count D D' (List.firstn kk gs') (List.firstn kk gs)) w)
          (sel_ihs D' D (List.firstn kk gs') (List.firstn kk gs) (List.firstn (cargs_nrec D (List.firstn kk gs)) ihs')).
    Proof.
      intros B1 B2 HB1 HB2 * HX Har Hia Hir LM Lw Hci.
      assert (HPΓ : PER RΓ) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRΓ).
      assert (HB12 : RΓ B1 B2) by (etransitivity; [ exact HB1 | symmetry; exact HB2 ]).
      destruct (con_args_rel_len _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hia) as [Lv Lv'].
      destruct (rec_results_rel_len _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hir) as [Li Li'].
      pose proof HX as HX0; rewrite tele_rel_iff in HX0; destruct HX0 as (LX & LX' & _).
      unfold T in LX, LX'; rewrite List.length_rev, length_im_nparams in LX, LX'.
      pose proof (nparams_rel_refl_l p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI _ _ HMv _ _ HX) as HXX.
      pose proof (cargs_same_kinds_length _ _ Hk) as Lgs.
      induction kk as [| kk IH]; intros Hkk; [ cbn; constructor |].
      destruct (nth_error_lt_some' gs kk ltac:(unfold na in Hkk; lia)) as [g Hg].
      destruct (nth_error_lt_some' gs' kk ltac:(unfold na in Hkk; lia)) as [g' Hg'].
      assert (Heq0 : gs = List.firstn kk gs ++ g :: List.skipn (S kk) gs)
        by (rewrite <- (skipn_nth_cons' _ _ _ Hg), List.firstn_skipn; reflexivity).
      assert (Heq0' : gs' = List.firstn kk gs' ++ g' :: List.skipn (S kk) gs')
        by (rewrite <- (skipn_nth_cons' _ _ _ Hg'), List.firstn_skipn; reflexivity).
      assert (Lk : List.length (List.firstn kk gs) = kk) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; unfold na in Hkk; lia).
      assert (Lk' : List.length (List.firstn kk gs') = kk) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; unfold na in Hkk; lia).
      pose proof (IH ltac:(lia)) as IHk.
      rewrite (firstn_S_snoc _ _ _ Hg), (firstn_S_snoc _ _ _ Hg').
      set (G1 := List.firstn kk gs) in *; set (G1' := List.firstn kk gs') in *.
      set (G2 := List.skipn (S kk) gs) in *; set (G2' := List.skipn (S kk) gs') in *.
      assert (Hkk' : cargs_same_kinds (G1' ++ g' :: G2') (G1 ++ g :: G2)) by (rewrite <- Heq0, <- Heq0'; exact Hk).
      destruct (cargs_same_kinds_app_inv G1' G1 (g' :: G2') (g :: G2) ltac:(lia) Hkk') as [Hk1 Hkg].
      rewrite wrap_ihs_ctx_app, cargs_container_count_app, sel_ihs_app by exact Hk1.
      rewrite List.firstn_firstn, Nat.min_l by (rewrite cargs_nrec_app'; lia).
      destruct g' as [A' | t'], g as [A | t]; cbn in Hkg; try contradiction; cbn [wrap_ihs_ctx List.app cargs_container_count cargs_nrec sel_ihs].
      all: rewrite ?Nat.add_0_r, ?List.app_nil_r; try exact IHk.
An argument recursive in both: its entries, one per leaf path the container has.
      clear Hkg IH.
      set (ls0 := shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) 0 t) in *.
      set (ls := shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) (pat_nargs (cargs_pat G1) + nn) t) in *.
      set (nin1 := cargs_container_count D D' G1' G1) in *.
      destruct (rec_results_rel_at _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hir G1 t G2 Heq0)

The environments of the wrapped branch's context at such arguments and results.
    Lemma canonical_wrap : forall B1 B2, RΓ B1 C1 -> RΓ B2 C1 ->
        forall X X' vs vs' ihsM w ihs',
        tele_rel (nr v) T X X' ->
        tele_rel (ar v X c) (cargs_nonrec gs) (nonrec_arg_vals gs vs) (nonrec_arg_vals gs vs') ->
        con_args_rel p D (admissible_index_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr v u0 u0 X X' T gs vs vs' ->
        rec_results_rel D dr Rel v u0 u0 X X' T gs vs vs' (merge_ihs D' D gs' gs ihsM w) ihs' ->
        List.length ihsM = cargs_nrec D gs -> List.length w = cargs_container_count D D' gs' gs ->
        forall RB, EF wrap_bctx p D D' Mv gs' gs As Us ++ Γ ≈ wrap_bctx p D D' Mv gs' gs As Us ++ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RB ->
        RB (env_tele B1 (List.rev (wrap_bctx p D D' Mv gs' gs As Us)) (X ++ vs ++ w))
           (env_tele B2 (List.rev (wrap_bctx p D D' Mv gs' gs As Us)) (X' ++ vs' ++ sel_ihs D' D gs' gs ihs')).
    Proof.
      intros B1 B2 HB1 HB2 * HX Har Hia Hir LM Lw RB HRB.
      assert (HPΓ : PER RΓ) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRΓ).
      assert (HB12 : RΓ B1 B2) by (etransitivity; [ exact HB1 | symmetry; exact HB2 ]).
      destruct (con_args_rel_len _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hia) as [Lv Lv'].
      destruct (rec_results_rel_len _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hir) as [Li Li'].
      pose proof HX as HX0; rewrite tele_rel_iff in HX0; destruct HX0 as (LX & LX' & _).
      unfold T in LX, LX'; rewrite List.length_rev, length_im_nparams in LX, LX'.
      pose proof (cargs_same_kinds_length _ _ Hk) as Lgs.
      destruct (us_class VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs HUss C1 u0 HUC B1 HB1) as (u1 & Hu1 & H10).
      destruct (us_class VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs HUss C1 u0 HUC B2 HB2) as (u2 & Hu2 & H20).
      pose proof (EB closed_args_tele_args v Mv c gs HMv Hcon X X' vs vs' HX Har Hia (List.length gs) (le_n _)) as Hcg.
      rewrite List.firstn_all, !List.firstn_all2 in Hcg by lia.
      assert (HKa : all_assumptions ((cargs_ctx p D Mv gs ++ im_nparams Mv) ++ ind_uparams D))
        by (rewrite <- List.app_assoc; fold (im_params D Mv); apply List.Forall_app; split;
            [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | exact (member_params_ass D Hc v Mv HMv) ]).
      assert (HK : ⊨ (cargs_ctx p D Mv gs ++ im_nparams Mv) ++ ind_uparams D)
        by (rewrite <- List.app_assoc; fold (im_params D Mv); exact (valid_group_cargs_sem p D Hvg Hcv v Mv c gs HMv Hcon)).
      pose proof (branch_context_recursive_results_prefix_valid p D Γ Us Bks Mv gs HB nil gs eq_refl) as HC0; cbn [ihs_ctx_aux List.app] in HC0; rewrite con_inst_ctx_eq in HC0.
      pose proof (EB canonical_gen _ HKa HK HC0 B1 B2 u1 u2 HB12 Hu1 Hu2 H10 H20 _ _ Hcg
                    ltac:(rewrite !List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx, length_im_nparams; lia)) as Hci.
      rewrite tele_sub_app, length_im_nparams in Hci; fold τU nn Cs Ns TB in Hci.
      pose proof (canonical_wrap_ihs B1 B2 HB1 HB2 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HX Har Hia Hir LM Lw Hci na (le_n _)) as Hih.
      unfold na in Hih; rewrite (List.firstn_all gs), (List.firstn_all2 gs'), !List.firstn_all2 in Hih by lia.
      pose proof (WB valid_wrap_bctx) as HW.
      unfold As in HRB |- *; rewrite (WB wrapping_ctx_eq) in HW, HRB.
      fold nn na As τU Cs Ns in HW, HRB |- *.
      set (Wc := wrap_ihs_ctx D D' nn As Us na nil 0 gs' gs) in HW, HRB, Hih.
      assert (Ewc : wrap_bctx p D D' Mv gs' gs As Us = Wc ++ Cs ++ Ns)
        by (apply (List.app_inv_tail Γ); unfold As; rewrite (WB wrapping_ctx_eq); rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
      rewrite Ewc.
      replace (Wc ++ Cs ++ Ns ++ Γ) with ((Wc ++ Cs ++ Ns) ++ Γ) in HW, HRB by (rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
      rewrite (List.app_assoc X), (List.app_assoc X').
      eapply (tele_args_env_rel_gen _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HRΓ HRB HW HB12).
      - unfold Wc; rewrite !List.length_app, length_wrap_ihs_ctx by exact Hk.
        unfold Cs, Ns; rewrite !length_tele_sub, length_cargs_ctx, length_im_nparams; unfold nn, na, im_nn in *; lia.
      - rewrite List.rev_app_distr; apply per_tele_args_app_intro;
          [ unfold Cs, Ns; rewrite List.length_rev, !List.length_app, !length_tele_sub, length_cargs_ctx, length_im_nparams;
            unfold nn, im_nn in *; lia | exact Hci | exact Hih ].
    Qed.

The Group's Recursive Results in the Wrapped Branch's Context

The group's eliminator along the leaf paths of the arguments, as the wrapped branch's instance has it (wrap_branch_sub), at an environment of the wrapped branch's context over C1 whose arguments are related to vs': related to the group's own recursive results at vs'. The frame of each argument is that of the branch's context extended by the wrapped branch's results (Elim.branch_entry_frame); the walk is Iota.leaf_ihs_vals.
    Let Ew := wrap_ihs_ctx D D' nn As Us na nil 0 gs' gs.
    Let Rw := List.length Ew.
    Let nw := Rw + na + nn.
    Let Uw := List.map (fun U => U[wk_shiftn nw]ʷ) Us.
    Let Bw := blocks_wk Bks (wk_shiftn nw).
    Let Aw := vars_from Rw na.
    Let σw := wrap_base Us nn na Rw.
C1's entries of Γ are tagged at Γ, as a substitution's value's are: a weakening into Γ past its extensions evaluates to C1 itself (Iota.leaf_ihs_vals).
    Hypothesis (HCa : env_agree_upto (List.length Γ) C1 (ctx_retag Γ C1)).
    #[local] Abbreviation LV f := (f VP p D HP HPD Γ Us Bks iA HΓ HUl HUs HUss
       (valid_blocks_len _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk) (valid_blocks_binder_count _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk) HMall HAv (valid_blocks_names _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk)
       (valid_blocks_bctx _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk) (valid_blocks_arity _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk) (valid_blocks_branch _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk)
       RΓ RU HRΓ HRU C1 u0 HC11 HUC HCa).

The group's eliminator along the leaf paths of a recursive argument, as the wrapped branch's instance has it, is that of the argument's frame in the branch's context extended by the wrapped results.
    Lemma wrap_leaf_ihs_eq : forall gs1 t gs2, gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
        List.map (leaf_ih ak_relevant p (List.map (fun U => U[sb_of_wk (wk_shiftn nw)]) Us) (blocks_sub Bks (sb_of_wk (wk_shiftn nw)))
                    (ihs_sub nn Us na (cargs_pat gs1) Rw) (a_var (Rw + na - 1 - List.length (cargs_pat gs1))))
          (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) (nn + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) t)
        = List.map (leaf_ih ak_relevant p Uw Bw (cargs_sub σw gs1 Aw) (a_var (Rw + (na - 1 - List.length gs1))))
            (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) (pat_nargs (cargs_pat gs1) + nn) t).
    Proof.
      intros * Heq.
      assert (Hlt : List.length gs1 < na) by (unfold na; rewrite Heq, List.length_app; cbn; lia).
      rewrite map_sub_of_wk, blocks_sub_of_wk, length_cargs_pat; fold Uw Bw.
      replace (Rw + na - 1 - List.length gs1) with (Rw + (na - 1 - List.length gs1)) by lia.
      rewrite pat_nargs_cargs_pat, cargs_nonrec_ctx_rev_tele, List.length_rev, length_cargs_nonrec_tele,
        (Nat.add_comm (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) nn).
      apply List.map_ext_in; intros l Hinl; rewrite (Nat.add_comm nn) in Hinl.
      pose proof (member_closed_recs _ _ (decl_closed_members _ Hc _ _ HMv) _ _ _ _ _ (cons_lookup_in _ _ _ Hcon) Heq) as Hst.
      rewrite cargs_nonrec_ctx_rev_tele, List.length_rev, length_cargs_nonrec_tele in Hst.
      assert (Hsl : leaf_scoped (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + nn + ind_nu D) l).
      { assert (Hst' : ptyp_scoped (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + nn + ind_nu D) t)
          by (replace (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + nn + ind_nu D) with (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + im_np D Mv)
                by (unfold im_np, nn, im_nn; lia); exact Hst).
        pose proof (shape_leaves_scoped (rview_leaves D) (ind_nu D) t (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + nn) (rview_leaves_scoped D Hc) Hst')
          as HF.
        rewrite List.Forall_forall in HF; exact (HF l Hinl). }
      assert (Hml : leaf_mvc l).
      { destruct (decl_mvc_members _ (decl_typed_mvc _ _ _ Hdt) _ _ HMv) as (_ & _ & Hmg).
        pose proof (Hmg _ _ (cons_lookup_in _ _ _ Hcon)) as Hm; rewrite Heq in Hm; apply List.Forall_app in Hm as [_ Hm].
        apply List.Forall_cons_iff in Hm as [[HmB HmP] _].
        pose proof (shape_leaves_mvc (rview_leaves D) t (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + nn) (rview_leaves_mvc _ (decl_typed_mvc _ _ _ Hdt))
                      HmB HmP) as HM.
        rewrite List.Forall_forall in HM; exact (HM _ Hinl). }
      eapply leaf_ih_mvc_agree; [ exact Hsl | exact Hml |].
      intros y _; apply ihs_sub_wrap; lia.
    Qed.

What the group's eliminator in the wrapped context gives at the arguments rest after gs1: the values of the instance's recursive results at the wrapped context's environment, against the group's own at vs'.
    #[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
    Record wrap_ihs_vals_out (X X' vs vs' w : list domain) (vtsW : list (domain * entry_type)) (gs1 rest : list carg) : Prop :=
      mk_wrap_ihs_vals_out
      {
The values of the instance's recursive results
        wrap_ihs_vals_terms : list domain
        
The group's own recursive results at vs'
      ; wrap_ihs_vals_own : list domain
        
The instance's, at the wrapped context's environment
      ; wrap_ihs_vals_eval_terms :
          ⟦ elim_ihs ak_relevant p D Uw Bw (cargs_sub σw gs1 Aw) (pat_nargs (cargs_pat gs1) + nn) rest (List.skipn (List.length gs1) Aw) ⟧*
            gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ env_extend_typed C1 vtsW ↘ wrap_ihs_vals_terms
        
The group's own, at C1
      ; wrap_ihs_vals_eval_own : ⟦ihs List.skipn (List.length gs1) vs' of rest under p u0 Bks ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C1 ↘ wrap_ihs_vals_own
        
Related as recursive results
      ; wrap_ihs_vals_related :
          rec_results_rel D dr Rel v u0 u0 (X ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs))
            (X' ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs')) (T ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) rest
            (List.skipn (List.length gs1) vs) (List.skipn (List.length gs1) vs') wrap_ihs_vals_terms wrap_ihs_vals_own }.

    Lemma wrap_ihs_vals : forall RS, EF Ew ++ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mv Us gs ≈ Ew ++ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mv Us gs ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RS ->
        forall X X' vs vs' w vtsW, List.map fst vtsW = X ++ vs ++ w ->
        RS (env_extend_typed C1 vtsW) (env_extend_typed C1 vtsW) ->
        List.length X = nn -> List.length w = Rw ->
        tele_rel (nr v) T X X' ->
        tele_rel (ar v X c) (cargs_nonrec gs) (nonrec_arg_vals gs vs) (nonrec_arg_vals gs vs') ->
        con_args_rel p D (admissible_index_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr v u0 u0 X X' T gs vs vs' ->
        con_args_rel p D (admissible_index_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr v u0 u0 X X T gs vs vs ->
        forall rest gs1, gs = gs1 ++ rest -> wrap_ihs_vals_out X X' vs vs' w vtsW gs1 rest.
    Proof.
      intros RS HRS X X' vs vs' w vtsW Hvw HE LX Lw HX Har Hia Hia0.
      assert (HPΓ : PER RΓ) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRΓ).
      destruct (con_args_rel_len _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hia) as [Lv Lv'].
      pose proof (nparams_rel_refl_l p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI _ _ HMv _ _ HX) as HXX.
      assert (HCtx : ⊨ Ew ++ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mv Us gs) by (rewrite con_inst_ctx_eq, tele_sub_app, length_im_nparams, <- List.app_assoc; exact (WB wrap_full_HE)).
      assert (HRS0 : EF (Ew ++ tele_sub (cargs_ctx p D Mv gs ++ im_nparams Mv) τU) ++ Γ
                       ≈ (Ew ++ tele_sub (cargs_ctx p D Mv gs ++ im_nparams Mv) τU) ++ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RS)
        by (rewrite con_inst_ctx_eq in HRS; rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact HRS).
      induction rest as [| g rest IH]; intros gs1 Heq.
      - assert (E1 : List.skipn (List.length gs1) vs = nil) by (apply List.skipn_all2; rewrite Lv, Heq, List.app_nil_r; lia).
        assert (E2 : List.skipn (List.length gs1) vs' = nil) by (apply List.skipn_all2; rewrite Lv', Heq, List.app_nil_r; lia).
        apply (mk_wrap_ihs_vals_out _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ nil nil); rewrite ?E1, ?E2; [ cbn; constructor | constructor | constructor ].
      - enough (H : exists ihsE own,
                   ⟦ elim_ihs ak_relevant p D Uw Bw (cargs_sub σw gs1 Aw) (pat_nargs (cargs_pat gs1) + nn) (g :: rest)
                       (List.skipn (List.length gs1) Aw) ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ env_extend_typed C1 vtsW ↘ ihsE /\
                   ⟦ihs List.skipn (List.length gs1) vs' of g :: rest under p u0 Bks ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C1 ↘ own /\
                   rec_results_rel D dr Rel v u0 u0 (X ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs))
                     (X' ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs')) (T ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) (g :: rest)
                     (List.skipn (List.length gs1) vs) (List.skipn (List.length gs1) vs') ihsE own)
          by (destruct H as (ihsE & own & H1 & H2 & H3); exact (mk_wrap_ihs_vals_out _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ihsE own H1 H2 H3)).
        assert (Hlt : List.length gs1 < List.length vs) by (rewrite Lv, Heq, List.length_app; cbn; lia).
        destruct (nth_error_lt_some vs _ Hlt) as [x Hx].
        destruct (nth_error_lt_some vs' (List.length gs1) ltac:(lia)) as [x' Hx'].
        assert (Lf : List.length (List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs) = List.length gs1) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; lia).
        assert (Lf' : List.length (List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs') = List.length gs1) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; lia).
        assert (Heq' : gs = (gs1 ++ g :: nil) ++ rest) by (rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact Heq).
        destruct (IH _ Heq') as [ihc ihe Ec Ee Hr].
        rewrite List.length_app in Ec, Ee, Hr; cbn [List.length] in Ec, Ee, Hr; rewrite Nat.add_1_r in Ec, Ee, Hr.
        rewrite (firstn_S_nth _ _ _ Hx), (firstn_S_nth _ _ _ Hx'), !nonrec_arg_vals_app in Hr by assumption.
        rewrite cargs_nonrec_tele_app in Hr.
        assert (HAw : List.skipn (List.length gs1) Aw = a_var (Rw + (na - 1 - List.length gs1)) :: List.skipn (S (List.length gs1)) Aw)
          by exact (WB wrap_full_avar gs1 g rest Heq).
        rewrite (skipn_nth_cons _ _ _ Hx), (skipn_nth_cons _ _ _ Hx'), HAw.
        rewrite cargs_pat_snoc in Ec.
        destruct g as [rB B0 | t].
        + assert (Hsa : cargs_sub σw (gs1 ++ ca_arg rB B0 :: nil) Aw = (cargs_sub σw gs1 Aw ,, a_var (Rw + (na - 1 - List.length gs1))))
            by exact (WB wrap_full_sub_arg gs1 rB B0 rest Heq).
          rewrite Hsa in Ec; cbn [nonrec_arg_vals pat_nargs cargs_nonrec List.map] in Hr, Ec; rewrite !List.app_assoc in Hr.
          exists ihc, ihe; split; [ cbn [elim_ihs]; exact Ec | split; [ constructor; exact Ee |] ].
          apply rec_results_arg; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc in Hr |- *; exact Hr.
        + assert (Hsr : cargs_sub σw (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil) Aw = cargs_sub σw gs1 Aw) by exact (WB wrap_full_sub_rec gs1 t rest Heq).
          rewrite Hsr in Ec; cbn [nonrec_arg_vals pat_nargs cargs_nonrec List.map] in Hr, Ec; rewrite !List.app_nil_r in Hr.
          destruct (length_rec_ps D HD v Mv HMv c gs gs1 t rest Hcon Heq) as (Mj & HMj & _).
          set (nv := nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs)) in *.
          set (nv' := nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs')) in *.
          destruct (con_args_rel_at _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hia gs1 t rest Heq) as (y & y' & Hy & Hy' & Hsh).
          rewrite Hx in Hy; injection Hy as <-; rewrite Hx' in Hy'; injection Hy' as <-.
          destruct (con_args_rel_at _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hia0 gs1 t rest Heq) as (z & z' & Hz & Hz' & Hsh0).
          rewrite Hx in Hz, Hz'; injection Hz as <-; injection Hz' as <-.
          assert (HKl : List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) <= List.length (cargs_nonrec gs))
            by (rewrite Heq, cargs_nonrec_app, List.length_app; lia).
          assert (Hpk : tele_prefix_rel (ar v X c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) nv nv).
          { assert (Hpk0 : tele_prefix_rel (ar v X c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) nv nv').
            { rewrite <- (List.firstn_skipn (List.length gs1) vs), <- (List.firstn_skipn (List.length gs1) vs') in Har.
              exact (nonrec_prefix_gen _ gs gs1 (ca_rec t :: rest) _ _ _ _ Heq Lf Lf' Har). }
            exact (args_rel_pre_refl_l p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI v Mv HMv X c gs HXX Hcon _ _ _ HKl Hpk0). }
          
The argument's frame in the wrapped context, at C1.
          set (L := X ++ List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs ++ x :: List.skipn (S (List.length gs1)) vs ++ w).
          assert (EL : X ++ vs ++ w = L).
          { unfold L; rewrite <- (List.firstn_skipn (List.length gs1) vs) at 1; rewrite (skipn_nth_cons _ _ _ Hx).
            rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity. }
          assert (Ls : List.length (List.skipn (S (List.length gs1)) vs) = List.length rest)
            by (rewrite List.length_skipn, Lv, Heq, List.length_app; cbn; lia).
          assert (Hvw' : List.map fst vtsW = X ++ List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs ++ x :: List.skipn (S (List.length gs1)) vs ++ w)
            by (rewrite Hvw, EL; reflexivity).
          assert (LL : List.length L = (Rw + na + nn))
            by (unfold L; rewrite !List.length_app; cbn [List.length]; rewrite List.length_app, Lf, LX, Lw, List.length_skipn, Lv;
                unfold na; lia).
          assert (LvW : List.length vtsW = List.length Ew + List.length gs + im_nn Mv)
            by (rewrite <- (List.length_map fst), Hvw, EL, LL; reflexivity).
          destruct (EBr side_w gs1 t rest Heq Ew HCtx RS HRS C1 vtsW HC11 LvW HE) as (wu & Hwu & HwU & Lwu).
          pose proof (EBr branch_entry_vals gs1 t rest Heq Ew HCtx RS HRS C1 vtsW X (List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs) x
                        (List.skipn (S (List.length gs1)) vs) w wu HC11 Hvw' LX Lf Ls Lw HE Hwu HwU Lwu) as Hvals.
          pose proof (EBr branch_entry_frame gs1 t rest Heq Ew HCtx) as Hf.
          assert (Hlink : iota_arg_link p D Γ C1 u0 v (X ++ nv ++ nil) (T ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn 0 (shape_doms_tele t))
                            (ptyp_skip 0 t) x (apps_vars_iter 0 (a_var (Rw + na - 1 - List.length (cargs_pat gs1)))) (vtsW ++ nil)).
          { intros Δ RΔ zs _ _ _; cbn [apps_vars_iter ptyp_skip List.firstn]; exists (X ++ nv ++ nil), x; split;
              [| rewrite !List.app_nil_r; exact Hsh0 ].
            cbn [exp_wk wk_shiftn].
            replace x with (env_var (env_extend_typed C1 ((vtsW ++ nil) ++ zs)) (Rw + na - 1 - List.length (cargs_pat gs1) + List.length zs));
              [ constructor |].
            rewrite env_var_extend_typed by (rewrite !List.length_app, LvW, length_cargs_pat; cbn [List.length]; unfold na in *; lia).
            rewrite !List.length_app, LvW, length_cargs_pat; cbn [List.length].
            replace (List.length Ew + List.length gs + im_nn Mv + 0 + List.length zs - 1 - (Rw + na - 1 - List.length gs1 + List.length zs))
              with (nn + List.length gs1) by (unfold Rw, na, nn in *; lia).
            rewrite !List.map_app, Hvw', List.app_nil_r.
            rewrite List.app_nth1 by (rewrite !List.length_app; cbn [List.length]; rewrite List.length_app, Lf, LX; lia).
            rewrite List.app_nth2 by lia; rewrite LX, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_sub.
            rewrite List.app_nth2 by lia; rewrite Lf, Nat.sub_diag; reflexivity. }
          destruct (LV leaf_ihs_vals (S (ptyp_mem t)) v Mv c gs gs1 t rest HMv Hcon Heq Mj HMj (fun _ => Nat.lt_succ_diag_r _)
                      _ _ _ _ Hf RS HRS0 X nv vtsW wu X nv x Hvals HXX Hpk 0 nil nil x x' (X' ++ nv')
                      (Nat.le_0_l _) eq_refl (List.Forall_nil _) (tele_prefix_rel_nil _)
                      ltac:(cbn [ptyp_skip List.map List.firstn]; rewrite !List.app_nil_r; exact Hsh) Hlink)
            as [rs' rs Ers' Ers Hrs].
          cbn [ptyp_skip sb_shift_iter sb_qn apps_vars_iter List.map List.firstn] in Ers, Ers', Hrs.
          rewrite Nat.add_0_r in Ers'.
          change (List.length Ew) with Rw in Ers'; change (List.length gs) with na in Ers'; change (im_nn Mv) with nn in Ers'.
          change (Rw + na + nn) with nw in Ers'; rewrite (wrap_leaf_ihs_eq gs1 t rest Heq) in Ers'.
          rewrite List.app_nil_r in Ers'; clear Hlink Hvals Hf Hwu.
          exists (rs' ++ ihc), (rs ++ ihe); split; [| split ].
          * cbn [elim_ihs]; apply eval_exps_app; [ exact Ers' | exact Ec ].
          * constructor; [ exact Ers | exact Ee ].
          * apply rec_results_rec; [| | rewrite !List.app_nil_r in Hrs; exact Hrs | exact Hr ].
            -- rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Ers'), List.length_map; apply length_shape_leaves.
            -- exact (proj1 (proj2 eval_ih_length_all) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ers D Hl Hlc).
    Qed.

A Wrapped Branch against the Group's Branch

The wrapped branch of the constructor c at an environment over C1 of the container's arguments and results, against the group's branch at C1 at related arguments: related values, at the motive. The wrapped branch is the group's at the instance wrap_branch_sub (gsub_wrap_branch), whose value is the group's branch's environment at the group's results merged with the container's (wrap_ihs_vals, eval_wrap_ihs, cross_merge_all).
    Variable (bv : eblock).
    Hypotheses (Hbv : List.nth_error Bks v = Some bv) (HrsQ : rview_struct_ok gc_deps gc_stack D')
      (Hcnt : cargs_container_count D D' gs' gs = cargs_nrec D' gs').

    Lemma wrap_branch_sub_eq : ViewBranch.wrap_branch_sub p D D' Us Bks Mv gs' gs
        = sb_of_list (sb_of_wk (wk_shiftn nw)) (vars_from (Rw + na) nn ++ Aw ++ wrap_ihs D' D gs' gs (elim_ihs ak_relevant p D Uw Bw σw nn gs Aw) 0 Rw).
    Proof.
      assert (HR : cargs_nrec D' gs' = Rw) by (rewrite <- Hcnt; symmetry; exact (WB wrap_full_R)).
      assert (Hna : List.length gs' = na) by exact (cargs_same_kinds_length _ _ Hk).
      unfold ViewBranch.wrap_branch_sub; cbv zeta; rewrite HR, Hna; change (im_nn Mv) with nn.
      replace (nn + na + Rw) with nw by (unfold nw; lia).
      reflexivity.
    Qed.

The sorts of the group's branch's context (BranchSorts).
    #[local] Abbreviation BSv f := (f VP p D HP HPD Γ Us Bks iA HΓ HUl HUs HUss (valid_blocks_len _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk)
       (valid_blocks_binder_count _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk) HMall HAv (valid_blocks_names _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk) (valid_blocks_bctx _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk)
       (valid_blocks_arity _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk) (valid_blocks_branch _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk) v Mv c gs HMv Hcon).

The value of the instance wrap_branch_sub at an environment of the wrapped branch's context over C1 of the container's arguments vs and results w: over C1, the values the group's branch's context takes there, the non-uniform parameters, the arguments and the group's results merged with the container's (merge_ihs), up to the proofs at the propositional arguments, kept there.
    Lemma wrap_sub_value : forall X vs w vtsW ihsE, List.map fst vtsW = X ++ vs ++ w ->
        List.length X = nn -> List.length vs = na -> List.length w = Rw ->
        forall RW, EF wrap_bctx p D D' Mv gs' gs As Us ++ Γ ≈ wrap_bctx p D D' Mv gs' gs As Us ++ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RW ->
        RW (env_extend_typed C1 vtsW) (env_extend_typed C1 vtsW) ->
        ⟦ elim_ihs ak_relevant p D Uw Bw σw nn gs Aw ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ env_extend_typed C1 vtsW ↘ ihsE ->
        exists wts, ⟦ ViewBranch.wrap_branch_sub p D D' Us Bks Mv gs' gs : elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mv gs As Us ++ Γ ⟧s
                      env_extend_typed C1 vtsW ↘ env_extend_typed C1 wts /\
          List.Forall (fun vt => entry_readable (de_term (fst vt) (snd vt))) wts /\
          List.length wts = List.length (X ++ vs ++ merge_ihs D' D gs' gs ihsE w) /\
          forall j x y, List.nth_error (X ++ vs ++ merge_ihs D' D gs' gs ihsE w) j = Some x -> List.nth_error (List.map fst wts) j = Some y ->
            x = y \/ (branch_context_entry_kind D gs (List.length (X ++ vs ++ merge_ihs D' D gs' gs ihsE w) - 1 - j) = ak_propositional /\ proof_readable y).
    Proof.
      intros X vs w vtsW ihsE Hvw LX Lv LwR RW HRW HEb EE.
      assert (HPΓ : PER RΓ) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRΓ).
      set (Eb := env_extend_typed C1 vtsW) in *.
      set (K0 := elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mv gs As Us).
      set (Ihs := elim_ihs ak_relevant p D Uw Bw σw nn gs Aw) in *.
      set (ihsT := merge_ihs D' D gs' gs ihsE w).
      set (Ms := vars_from (Rw + na) nn ++ Aw ++ wrap_ihs D' D gs' gs Ihs 0 Rw).
      assert (LK0 : List.length K0 = cargs_nrec D gs + List.length gs + im_nn Mv) by apply length_elim_bctx.
      assert (LIhs : List.length Ihs = cargs_nrec D gs) by (apply length_elim_ihs; unfold Aw; rewrite length_vars_from; reflexivity).
      assert (LE : List.length ihsE = cargs_nrec D gs) by (rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ EE); exact LIhs).
      assert (LT : List.length ihsT = cargs_nrec D gs) by (apply length_merge_ihs; [ exact Hk | exact LE ]).
      assert (Lvw : List.length vtsW = nw) by (rewrite <- (List.length_map fst), Hvw, !List.length_app, LX, Lv, LwR; unfold nw; lia).
The values of the instance's terms.
      assert (EMs : ⟦ Ms ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Eb ↘ X ++ vs ++ ihsT).
      { set (vX := List.firstn nn vtsW); set (vV := List.firstn na (List.skipn nn vtsW)); set (vW := List.skipn na (List.skipn nn vtsW)).
        assert (Esp : vtsW = vX ++ vV ++ vW) by (unfold vX, vV, vW; rewrite !List.firstn_skipn; reflexivity).
        assert (FX : List.map fst vX = X) by (unfold vX; rewrite <- List.firstn_map, Hvw, <- LX; apply firstn_app_exact; reflexivity).
        assert (FV : List.map fst vV = vs)
          by (unfold vV; rewrite <- List.firstn_map, <- List.skipn_map, Hvw, <- LX, skipn_app_exact, <- Lv by reflexivity;
              apply firstn_app_exact; reflexivity).
        assert (FW : List.map fst vW = w)
          by (unfold vW; rewrite <- !List.skipn_map, Hvw, <- LX, skipn_app_exact, <- Lv, skipn_app_exact by reflexivity; reflexivity).
        assert (LvX : List.length vX = nn) by (rewrite <- (List.length_map fst), FX; exact LX).
        assert (LvV : List.length vV = na) by (rewrite <- (List.length_map fst), FV; exact Lv).
        assert (LvW : List.length vW = Rw) by (rewrite <- (List.length_map fst), FW; exact LwR).
        pose proof EE as EE'; unfold Eb in EE' |- *; rewrite Esp in EE' |- *.
        apply eval_exps_app; [| apply eval_exps_app ].
        - pose proof (eval_vars_from_args vX C1 (vV ++ vW)) as H; rewrite List.length_app, LvV, LvW, LvX, FX in H.
          replace (Rw + na) with (na + Rw) by lia; exact H.
        - pose proof (eval_vars_from_args vV (env_extend_typed C1 vX) vW) as H; rewrite LvV, LvW, FV, <- env_extend_typed_app in H.
          exact H.
        - pose proof (eval_wrap_ihs D' D gs' gs Ihs ihsE C1 (vX ++ vV) vW 0 Hk LIhs ltac:(rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact EE')
                        ltac:(rewrite LvW; unfold Rw, Ew; rewrite length_wrap_ihs_ctx by exact Hk; lia)) as H.
          rewrite <- List.app_assoc, LvW, FW in H; exact H. }
      
The substitution's value.
      destruct (rel_sub_under_ctx_simple (gsub_valid (WB gsub_wrap_branch Hcnt))) as (R1 & HR1 & RT & HRT & Hs).
      assert (E1 : RW <~> R1) by (eapply per_ctx_env_right_irrel; [ exact HRW | exact HR1 ]).
      destruct (Hs _ _ (proj1 (E1 _ _) HEb)) as (e1 & e1' & Ee1 & _ & He1).
      assert (HPT : PER RT) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRT).
      assert (He11 : RT e1 e1) by (etransitivity; [ exact He1 | symmetry; exact He1 ]).
      pose proof (elim_bctx_ass ak_relevant p D v Mv gs As Us Hc HMv) as HK0a; fold K0 in HK0a.
The entries' propositionality is decided by their sorts.
      assert (Hdec : forall x, x < List.length K0 -> evaluated_kind (branch_context_entry_kind D gs x) ->
                       ~ entry_propositional gc_deps gc_stack (K0 ++ Γ) e1 x).
      { intros x Hx Hr.
        refine (evaluated_entry_not_propositional K0 Γ RT x HK0a Hx _ HRT e1 e1 He11).
        intros Δ1 κ0 T0 Δ2 E0 HΔ1.
        destruct (BSv branch_context_entry_sort RΓ RU HRΓ HRU C1 u0 HC11 HUC HrvMv Δ1 κ0 T0 Δ2 E0) as [i0 HT0].
        assert (Hek : branch_context_entry_kind D gs x = ak_relevant \/ branch_context_entry_kind D gs x = ak_level)
          by (destruct Hr; auto).
        rewrite HΔ1 in HT0; exists i0; destruct Hek as [Hek | Hek]; rewrite Hek in HT0; [ left | right ]; exact HT0. }
      assert (Hpr : forall x, x < List.length K0 -> branch_context_entry_kind D gs x = ak_propositional -> entry_propositional gc_deps gc_stack (K0 ++ Γ) e1 x).
      { intros x Hx Hr.
        refine (prop_entry_propositional K0 Γ RT x HK0a Hx _ HRT e1 e1 He11).
        intros Δ1 κ0 T0 Δ2 E0 HΔ1.
        destruct (BSv branch_context_entry_sort RΓ RU HRΓ HRU C1 u0 HC11 HUC HrvMv Δ1 κ0 T0 Δ2 E0) as [i0 HT0].
        rewrite HΔ1, Hr in HT0; exact HT0. }
      assert (LMs : List.length Ms = List.length K0)
        by (pose proof (eval_exps_length _ _ _ EMs) as H; rewrite !List.length_app, LX, Lv, LT in H; unfold Ms in H |- *; lia).
      assert (ETg : K0 ++ Γ = List.rev (List.rev K0) ++ Γ) by (rewrite List.rev_involutive; reflexivity).
      rewrite wrap_branch_sub_eq in Ee1; fold Ms in Ee1.
      change (elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mv gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us) with K0 in Ee1, HRT.
      rewrite ETg in Ee1, Hdec, Hpr.
      destruct (eval_sb_of_list_sorted_split Ms (List.rev K0) (sb_of_wk (wk_shiftn nw)) Γ Eb e1 (branch_context_entry_kind D gs)
                  ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev; lia) Ee1
                  ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev; exact Hdec) ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev; exact Hpr))
        as (ms & Lms & Hms & Hagr).
The value past the entries: C1.
      assert (Lpj : List.length (List.rev K0) = List.length Ms) by (rewrite List.length_rev; lia).
      pose proof (eval_sb_of_list_tail _ _ _ _ _ _ Lpj Ee1) as Htail.
      assert (Hwk : ⟦ sb_of_wk (wk_shiftn nw) : Γ ⟧s Eb ↘ C1).
      { pose proof (@eval_sub_of_wk gc_deps gc_stack Γ (wk_shiftn (List.length vtsW)) Eb (wk_mono_shiftn _)) as H.
        unfold Eb in H; rewrite eval_wk_shiftn_extend_typed, Lvw in H.
        exact (eval_sub_resp_agree _ _ _ _ _ H ltac:(symmetry; exact HCa)). }
      pose proof (functional_eval_sub _ _ _ _ _ Htail Hwk) as Hag.
      set (wts := tagged_entries Γ (List.rev K0) C1 ms).
      assert (HagT : env_agree_upto (List.length (List.rev (List.rev K0) ++ Γ)) e1 (env_extend_typed C1 wts)).
      { unfold wts; rewrite <- env_extend_tagged_typed, List.length_app, !List.length_rev.
        intros x Hx; rewrite Hagr.
        exact (env_extend_tagged_agree (List.rev K0) Γ _ _ ms ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev; lia) Hag x
                 ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev; lia)). }
      assert (Fw : List.map fst wts = ms) by (unfold wts; rewrite tagged_entries_fst by (rewrite List.length_rev; lia); reflexivity).
      exists wts; split; [ rewrite wrap_branch_sub_eq; fold Ms K0; rewrite ETg; exact (eval_sub_resp_agree _ _ _ _ _ Ee1 HagT)
                         | split; [| split ] ].
      - rewrite <- ETg in HagT; pose proof (per_ctx_env_resp_agree HRT _ _ _ _ HagT HagT He11) as HEσ.
        assert (HKr : ⊨ List.rev (List.rev K0) ++ Γ) by (rewrite List.rev_involutive; exact HB).
        assert (HRTr : EF List.rev (List.rev K0) ++ Γ ≈ List.rev (List.rev K0) ++ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RT)
          by (rewrite List.rev_involutive; exact HRT).
        assert (Lw' : List.length wts = List.length (List.rev K0))
          by (unfold wts; rewrite tagged_entries_length by (rewrite List.length_rev; lia); rewrite List.length_rev; lia).
        exact (proj1 (per_tele_args_of_env_extend_readable _ _ _ _ HRΓ HKr (List.Forall_rev HK0a) HRTr _ _ _ _ Lw' Lw' HEσ)).
      - rewrite <- (List.length_map fst), Fw, Lms, LMs, LK0, !List.length_app, LX, Lv, LT; unfold nn, na; lia.
      - intros j x y Hx Hy; rewrite Fw in Hy.
        assert (Lxs : List.length (X ++ vs ++ ihsT) = List.length Ms) by (rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ EMs); reflexivity).
        destruct (nth_error_lt_some' Ms j ltac:(rewrite <- Lxs; apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence)) as [M HM].
        destruct (Hms j M y HM Hy) as [HmR HmP].
        destruct (eval_exps_nth _ _ _ _ _ EMs HM) as (x' & Hx' & Ex').
        rewrite Hx in Hx'; injection Hx' as <-.
        rewrite Lxs; destruct (evaluated_kind_or_propositional (branch_context_entry_kind D gs (List.length Ms - 1 - j))) as [Er | Er].
        + left; exact (functional_eval_exp _ _ _ _ Ex' (HmR Er)).
        + right; split; [ exact Er |].
          rewrite (HmP Er).
A propositional entry is an argument's, a variable.
          pose proof (nth_error_lt_length _ _ _ HM) as Hj.
          destruct (branch_entry_sort_propositional_range _ _ _ Er) as [Hr1 Hr2].
          rewrite LMs, LK0 in Hr1, Hr2, Hj.
          assert (HM' : List.nth_error Aw (j - nn) = Some M).
          { unfold Ms in HM; rewrite List.nth_error_app2 in HM by (rewrite length_vars_from; unfold nn; lia).
            rewrite length_vars_from, List.nth_error_app1 in HM by (unfold Aw; rewrite length_vars_from; unfold nn, na; lia).
            exact HM. }
          unfold Aw in HM'; destruct (vars_from_nth_error _ _ _ _ HM') as [_ ->].
          refine (proj1 (per_ctx_env_kept_proof_readable _ _ _ _ HRW _ _ _ HEb)).
          cbn [exp_free_bound]; rewrite List.length_app, length_wrap_bctx by exact Hk.
          assert (HRw : Rw = cargs_container_count D D' gs' gs) by (unfold Rw, Ew; apply length_wrap_ihs_ctx; exact Hk).

    Qed.

What a wrapped branch Ba moved by wrap_branch_sub gives against the group's branch Ba, at the container's arguments vs and results w and the group's vs' and ihs of the constructor d_con hd k c.
    #[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
    Record wrap_branch_out (Ba : exp) (bs bs' vs vs' w ihs : list domain) (hd : qname) (k : nat) (ts ts' : list entry_type) : Prop :=
      mk_wrap_branch_out
      {
The wrapped branch's value
        wrap_branch_val : domain
        
The group's branch's value
      ; wrap_branch_val' : domain
        
The wrapped branch, at the container's arguments and results, at the types ts
      ; wrap_branch_eval :
          ⟦ Ba[ViewBranch.wrap_branch_sub p D D' Us Bks Mv gs' gs] ⟧
            env_extend_typed C1 (List.combine (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs ++ vs ++ w) ts) ↘ wrap_branch_val
        
The group's branch, at the group's, at the types ts'
      ; wrap_branch_eval' : ⟦ Ba ⟧ env_extend_typed C1 (List.combine (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs' ++ vs' ++ ihs) ts') ↘ wrap_branch_val'
        
Related at the motive
      ; wrap_branch_related : Rel v (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs) (d_con hd k c (bs ++ vs)) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs')
          (d_con hd k c (bs' ++ vs')) wrap_branch_val wrap_branch_val'
        
The wrapped branch moved by a substitution into C1's class: related to the group's branch's value
      ; wrap_branch_moved : forall Γ' RΓ' σ0 ρ0, EF Γ' ≈ Γ' ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RΓ' -> Γ' ⊨ˢ σ0 ≈ σ0 : Γ -> RΓ' ρ0 ρ0 ->
          ⟦ σ0 : Γ ⟧s ρ0 ↘ C1 ->
          exists r0, ⟦ Ba[ViewBranch.wrap_branch_sub p D D' Us Bks Mv gs' gs][sb_qn (im_nn Mv + List.length gs' + cargs_nrec D' gs') σ0] ⟧
                       env_extend_typed ρ0 (List.combine (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs ++ vs ++ w) ts) ↘ r0 /\
            Rel v (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs) (d_con hd k c (bs ++ vs)) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs') (d_con hd k c (bs' ++ vs'))
              r0 wrap_branch_val' }.

    Lemma wrap_branch_rel : forall na0 Ba, brs_lookup (eb_brs bv) c = Some (na0, Ba) ->
        forall u u' bs bs' vs vs' w ihs hd k ts ts',
        G v u u' (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs') (d_con hd k c (bs ++ vs)) (d_con hd k c (bs' ++ vs')) ->
        cross_fields_rel D D' dr Rel C1 p u0 Bks v u u' (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs') T gs' gs vs vs' w ihs ->
        List.Forall2 (fun v t => entry_readable (de_term v t)) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs ++ vs ++ w) ts ->
        List.Forall2 (fun v t => entry_readable (de_term v t)) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs' ++ vs' ++ ihs) ts' ->
        wrap_branch_out Ba bs bs' vs vs' w ihs hd k ts ts'.
    Proof.
      intros na0 Ba HBa * Hm Hcr Ht Ht'.
      assert (HPΓ : PER RΓ) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRΓ).
      destruct (cross_fields_rel_vs_len D D' dr Rel C1 p u0 Bks _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hcr) as [Lv Lv'].
      pose proof (cross_fields_rel_w_len D D' dr Rel C1 p u0 Bks _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hcr) as Lw.
      assert (LwR : List.length w = Rw) by (rewrite Lw; unfold Rw, Ew; rewrite length_wrap_ihs_ctx by exact Hk; reflexivity).
      destruct (ind_rel_con_len _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm HMv HrvMv Hcon Lv Lv') as [Lbs Lbs'].
      destruct (ind_rel_con_inv p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm HMv HrvMv Lbs)
        as (gs0 & bs1 & vs1 & Ez & _ & HX & Hcon0 & Lbs1 & _ & _ & _ & Hia).
      rewrite Hcon in Hcon0; injection Hcon0 as <-; injection Ez as Ez.
      destruct (app_split_eq _ _ _ _ Ez ltac:(congruence)) as [<- <-].
      pose proof (ind_rel_rebase p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI _ _ _ u0 u0 _ _ _ _ Had Had Had Hm) as Hm0.
      destruct (ind_rel_con_inv p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm0 HMv HrvMv Lbs)
        as (gs0 & bs2 & vs2 & Ez0 & _ & _ & Hcon0 & Lbs2 & _ & _ & Har0 & Hia0).
      rewrite Hcon in Hcon0; injection Hcon0 as <-; injection Ez0 as Ez0.
      destruct (app_split_eq _ _ _ _ Ez0 ltac:(congruence)) as [<- <-].
      pose proof (proj1 (ind_rel_trans_all p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI (admissible_index_at D u0 nr)) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm0 _ _ _ _
                    (proj1 (ind_rel_sym_all p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI (admissible_index_at D u0 nr)) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm0)) as Hm00.
      destruct (ind_rel_con_inv p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm00 HMv HrvMv Lbs)
        as (gs0 & bs3 & vs3 & Ez1 & _ & _ & Hcon0 & Lbs3 & _ & _ & _ & Hia00).
      rewrite Hcon in Hcon0; injection Hcon0 as <-; injection Ez1 as Ez1.
      destruct (app_split_eq _ _ _ _ Ez1 ltac:(congruence)) as [<- <-].
      pose proof (proj2 (proj2 (cross_rebase_all D' HrsQ v u u')) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hcr Hia) as Hcr0.
      set (X := List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs) in *; set (X' := List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs') in *.
      assert (LX : List.length X = nn) by (unfold X; rewrite List.length_skipn; unfold nn; lia).
      assert (LX' : List.length X' = nn) by (unfold X'; rewrite List.length_skipn; unfold nn; lia).
      clear Ez Ez0 Ez1 Lbs1 Lbs2 Lbs3.
The group's own results at both sides, merged with the container's: the wrapped branch's context's environment.
      destruct (proj1 (proj2 self_elim_all) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hia0 Had Had) as (ihsL & ihsR & EL & ER & HLR).
      destruct (rec_results_rel_len _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HLR) as [LL LR].
      pose proof (proj2 (proj2 (cross_merge_all D' HrsQ v u0 u0)) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hcr0 ihsL ihsR Hia0 Had Had ER LL HLR) as Hm1.
      pose proof (WB valid_wrap_bctx) as HWE.
      destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HWE) as [RW HRW].
      assert (HPW : PER RW) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRW).
      pose proof (canonical_wrap C1 C1 HC11 HC11 X X' vs vs' ihsL w ihs HX Har0 Hia0 Hm1 LL Lw RW HRW) as Hcw.

Section CrossElim.
  #[local] Set Default Proof Using "All".
  Variable (VP : qname -> ind_decl -> Prop) (p : qname) (D : ind_decl).
  Hypotheses (HP : valid_groups VP) (HPD : VP p D).
  Let Hvg := valid_groups_valid VP HP p D HPD.
  Let Hcv := containers_valid_of_groups VP HP p D HPD.
  Let HD := valid_group_valid _ _ Hvg.
  Let Hc := valid_group_closed _ _ Hvg.

  Let Hdt := valid_group_typed _ _ Hvg.
  Let Hass := valid_group_ass _ _ Hvg.

  Variable (Γ : ctx) (RΓ : relation env).

  Variable (RU : relation env).

    (HUs : forall k N T, List.nth_error Us k = Some N -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id Us) k = Some T ->
             Γ ⊨ N : T)
    (HUss : List.Forall (exp_scoped (List.length Γ)) Us).
  Variable (C1 : env) (u0 : list domain).
  Hypotheses (HC11 : RΓ C1 C1) (HUC : ⟦ Us ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C1 ↘ u0).
  Variable (Bks : list eblock) (iA : nat).

  Let HMall := valid_blocks_mctx _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk.
  Let HAv := valid_blocks_motive _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk.
  Let nr := canon_nparams_rel D u0.
  Let ar := canon_args_rel D u0.
  Let dr := canon_doms_rel D u0.
  Let G := grp_rel p D u0 nr ar dr.
The family of the motives at C1, as Elim.v has it.

The view m of the container's member k', its map vm.
  Variable (qc : qname) (D' : ind_decl) (m : nat) (Mm : imember) (k' : nat) (Is : list exp) (vm : list nat).
  Hypotheses (Hq : ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack qc = Some D') (HMm : ind_member D m = Some Mm)
    (Hh : im_head Mm = mh_view qc k' Is vm).
  Let HgQ := valid_groups_valid VP HP qc D' (valid_groups_containers VP HP p D m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HPD HMm Hh Hq).
  Let HassQ := valid_group_ass _ _ HgQ.
  Let HlcQ : leaves_coherent D' := leaves_coherent_of_order D' (rview_struct_order _ _ _ (group_structure_record_struct _ HassQ)).

The container's eliminator: a block for each member with one.
  Variable (ρb : env) (VBb : list eblock) (ub : list domain).
  Hypotheses (Lub : List.length ub = ind_nu D')
    (HbB : forall i' Mi', ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> im_is_rview Mi' = false -> exists b, List.nth_error VBb i' = Some b)
    (HnmB : forall i' Mi' b, ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> List.nth_error VBb i' = Some b -> eb_binder_count b = S (im_nn Mi'))
    (HnaB : forall i' Mi' b, ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> List.nth_error VBb i' = Some b -> brs_names (im_cons Mi') (eb_brs b))
    (HarB : forall i' Mi' b c gs' n B, ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> List.nth_error VBb i' = Some b ->
              ind_con Mi' c = Some gs' -> In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b) -> n = (im_nn Mi' + List.length gs' + cargs_nrec D' gs')%nat).
The motives, at related indices and elements stored at any types they read back at (as IndElim's Hmot).
  Hypothesis (Hmot_x : forall i' Mi' v bb ba u u' ns ns' x x' ts ts', ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> im_is_rview Mi' = false ->
                List.nth_error vm i' = Some v -> List.nth_error VBb i' = Some bb -> List.nth_error Bks v = Some ba ->
                G v u u' ns ns' x x' ->
                List.Forall2 (fun v t => entry_readable (de_term v t)) (ns ++ x :: nil) ts ->
                List.Forall2 (fun v t => entry_readable (de_term v t)) (ns' ++ x' :: nil) ts' ->
                exists a a', ⟦ eb_motive bb ⟧ env_extend_typed ρb (List.combine (ns ++ x :: nil) ts) ↘ a /\
                  ⟦ eb_motive ba ⟧ env_extend_typed C1 (List.combine (ns' ++ x' :: nil) ts') ↘ a' /\
                  DF a ≈ a' ∈ per_univ_elem iA ↘ Rel v ns x ns' x' /\ not_level_sort a /\ domain_kind a <> ak_level).
The branches, at related constructors and related recursive results, their variables stored at any types they read back at (as IndElim's Hbr).
  Hypothesis (Hbr_x : forall i' Mi' v Mv bb ba c gs' gs nb na Bb Ba u u' bs bs' vs vs' w ihs hd k ts ts',
                ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> im_is_rview Mi' = false ->
                List.nth_error vm i' = Some v -> ind_member D v = Some Mv ->
                List.nth_error VBb i' = Some bb -> List.nth_error Bks v = Some ba ->
                ind_con Mi' c = Some gs' -> ind_con Mv c = Some gs ->
                brs_lookup (eb_brs bb) c = Some (nb, Bb) -> brs_lookup (eb_brs ba) c = Some (na, Ba) ->
                G v u u' (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs')
                  (d_con hd k c (bs ++ vs)) (d_con hd k c (bs' ++ vs')) ->
                cross_fields_rel D D' dr Rel C1 p u0 Bks v u u'
                  (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs') (List.rev (im_nparams Mv)) gs' gs vs vs' w ihs ->
                List.Forall2 (fun v t => entry_readable (de_term v t)) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs ++ vs ++ w) ts ->
                List.Forall2 (fun v t => entry_readable (de_term v t)) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs' ++ vs' ++ ihs) ts' ->
                exists r r', ⟦ Bb ⟧ env_extend_typed ρb (List.combine (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs ++ vs ++ w) ts) ↘ r /\
                  ⟦ Ba ⟧ env_extend_typed C1 (List.combine (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs' ++ vs' ++ ihs) ts') ↘ r' /\
                  Rel v (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs) (d_con hd k c (bs ++ vs))
                    (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs') (d_con hd k c (bs' ++ vs')) r r').
The container's branch's variables read back at the types its eliminator stores them at: the container's arguments' types at ub and its recursive results' types at VBb's motives.
  Hypothesis (Hcbr_x : forall i' Mi' v Mv c gs' gs u u' bs bs' vs vs' w ihs hd k,
                ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> im_is_rview Mi' = false ->
                List.nth_error vm i' = Some v -> ind_member D v = Some Mv ->
                ind_con Mi' c = Some gs' -> ind_con Mv c = Some gs ->
                G v u u' (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs')
                  (d_con hd k c (bs ++ vs)) (d_con hd k c (bs' ++ vs')) ->
                cross_fields_rel D D' dr Rel C1 p u0 Bks v u u'
                  (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs') (List.rev (im_nparams Mv)) gs' gs vs vs' w ihs ->
                List.Forall2 (fun v t => entry_readable (de_term v t)) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs ++ vs ++ w)
                  (List.map snd (branch_entries D' Mi' qc ub (blocks_motives VBb) ρb gs' (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs) vs w))).
The container's motive's variables at a neutral read back at the types its stuck eliminator stores them at: the container's non-uniform parameters' types at ub and its member's type there.
  Hypothesis (Hcmot_x : forall i' Mi' v Mv hd k as1 as2 e e' u u' ns ns',
                ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> im_is_rview Mi' = false ->
                List.nth_error vm i' = Some v -> ind_member D v = Some Mv ->
                G v u u' ns ns' (⇑ (d_ind hd k as1) e) (⇑ (d_ind hd k as2) e') ->
                exists cups, ⟦mref i' of qc ub ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (hd, k, cups) /\
                  List.Forall2 (fun v t => entry_readable (de_term v t))
                    (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) as1 ++ ⇑ (d_ind hd k as1) e :: nil)
                    (List.map snd (motive_entries D' Mi' ub (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) as1)
                                     (d_ind hd k (cups ++ List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) as1)) (⇑ (d_ind hd k as1) e)))).

The members of the container's group and those of the group the view's map takes them to.
  Lemma cross_member : forall i' j, List.nth_error vm i' = Some j ->
      exists Mi' Mj, ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' /\ view_member p D qc D' vm i' Mi' j Mj.
  Proof.
    intros i' j Hv.
    destruct (group_structure_view_wrap _ Hass _ _ _ _ _ _ HMm Hh) as (D2 & Hq2 & Hvw).
    rewrite Hq in Hq2; injection Hq2 as <-.
    assert (Hi : i' < List.length (ind_members D')) by (rewrite <- (view_wrap_ok_length _ _ _ Hvw); apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence).
    destruct (nth_error_lt_some' _ _ Hi) as [Mi' HMi'].
    destruct (view_agree_members p D m Mm qc k' Is vm D' Hass HMm Hh Hq i' Mi' HMi') as (v & Mv & Hvm).
    pose proof (view_member_v _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvm) as Hv'; rewrite Hv in Hv'; injection Hv' as <-.
    exists Mi', Mv; split; [ exact HMi' | exact Hvm ].
  Qed.

What the two eliminators give two related elements of the group's member j the view's map takes the container's member i' to: at members with a block, the eliminators' values, related at Rel; at record views, the recursive results of their fields at the projections.
  Inductive cross_member_results (i' j : nat) (u u' ns ns' : list domain) (x x' : domain) : Prop :=
  
Members with a block: the eliminators
  | cross_member_elim : forall Mi' Mj r r', ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> im_is_rview Mi' = false ->
      ind_member D j = Some Mj -> im_is_rview Mj = false ->
      ⟦elim x at i' of qc ub VBb ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρb ↘ r -> ⟦elim x' at j of p u0 Bks ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C1 ↘ r' ->
      Rel j ns x ns' x' r r' -> cross_member_results i' j u u' ns ns' x x'
  
Record views of one record and fields: their fields' recursive results
  | cross_member_rview : forall Mi' Mj qr Is' Is0 fl c' gs' c gs ws ws' rs rs',
      ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> im_head Mi' = mh_record qr Is' fl -> im_cons Mi' = (c', gs') :: nil ->
      ind_member D j = Some Mj -> im_head Mj = mh_record qr Is0 fl -> im_cons Mj = (c, gs) :: nil ->
      ⟦projs fl of x ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ ws -> ⟦projs fl of x' ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ ws' ->
      ⟦ihs ws of gs' under qc ub VBb ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρb ↘ rs ->
      ⟦ihs ws' of gs under p u0 Bks ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C1 ↘ rs' ->
      cross_fields_rel D D' dr Rel C1 p u0 Bks j u u' nil nil nil gs' gs ws ws' rs rs' ->
      cross_member_results i' j u u' ns ns' x x'.

The two eliminators' recursive results of related constructor arguments: the container's, the group's, and their relation.

Related

The stuck eliminator of each side at related neutrals of a member with a block: neutrals at the motives' values there, which are related at the family at the neutrals' own indices.
  Lemma cross_neut_values : forall i' j Mj hd k as1 as2 e e' w w' ns ns', List.nth_error vm i' = Some j ->
      ind_member D j = Some Mj -> im_is_rview Mj = false ->
      G j w w' ns ns' (⇑ (d_ind hd k as1) e) (⇑ (d_ind hd k as2) e') ->
      exists Mi' a a', ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' /\ im_is_rview Mi' = false /\
        ⟦elim ⇑ (d_ind hd k as1) e at i' of qc ub VBb ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρb ↘ ⇑ a (d_elim ρb VBb qc ub i' as1 e) /\
        ⟦elim ⇑ (d_ind hd k as2) e' at j of p u0 Bks ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C1 ↘ ⇑ a' (d_elim C1 Bks p u0 j as2 e') /\
        DF a ≈ a' ∈ per_univ_elem iA ↘ Rel j (List.skipn (im_unu D Mj) as1) (⇑ (d_ind hd k as1) e)
                                            (List.skipn (im_unu D Mj) as2) (⇑ (d_ind hd k as2) e') /\
        not_level_sort a /\ domain_kind a <> ak_level.
  Proof.
    intros * Hvi HM Hrv Hcur.
    pose proof Hcur as Hcur0.
    inversion Hcur0 as [| j0 Mj0 hd0 k0 ns0 ns0' as1' as2' e0 e0' w0 w0' HM0 Hrv0 Href Hn L1 L2 Hs1 Hs2 He |]; subst;
      [| rewrite HM in *; match goal with H : Some _ = Some _ |- _ => injection H as <- end;
         exfalso; eapply not_rview_record; eassumption ].
    rewrite HM in HM0; injection HM0 as <-.
    destruct (cross_member i' j Hvi) as (Mi' & Mk0 & HMi' & Hvmb).
    pose proof (view_member_mem _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as HMk0; rewrite HM in HMk0; injection HMk0 as <-.
    pose proof (view_member_nn _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as Hnn'.
    assert (HrvI : im_is_rview Mi' = false) by (rewrite <- (view_member_is_rview _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb); exact Hrv).
    pose proof (ind_rel_idx p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hcur Hs1 Hs2) as Hm.
    destruct (self_ref_target _ _ _ _ HM Href) as (Dq & Mq & Hq' & HMq & Hnnq & Hnuq).
    destruct (HbB _ _ HMi' HrvI) as [bb Hbb]; destruct (HBks _ _ HM Hrv) as [ba Hba].
The group's motive's variables read back at the types its stuck eliminator stores them at, by its own uniform parameters.
    pose proof self_ups_ok as [_ _ Aa _ _ Mb _ _ Rb _ _ _].
    destruct (XS mref_at_ref _ _ _ _ _ Mb HM Hrv Href) as [cupsb Hcb].
    pose proof (XS grp_rel_neut_rebase _ _ _ _ u0 u0 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hrv Hm) as Hm2.
    assert (Hrb : List.Forall2 (fun v t => entry_readable (de_term v t))
                    (List.skipn (im_unu D Mj) as2 ++ ⇑ (d_ind hd k as2) e' :: nil)
                    (List.map snd (motive_entries D Mj u0 (List.skipn (im_unu D Mj) as2)
                                     (d_ind hd k (cupsb ++ List.skipn (im_unu D Mj) as2)) (⇑ (d_ind hd k as2) e')))).
    { unfold motive_entries; rewrite List.map_app; apply List.Forall2_app;
        [ exact (nparams_entries_readable_at_admissible_base _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hass Aa HM Hs2)
        | constructor; [ exact (Rb _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hrv Aa Aa Hcb Hm2
                                   (nparams_rel_refl_r p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI j Mj HM _ _ Hs2))
                       | constructor ] ]. }
    
The container's, by its own.
    destruct (Hcmot_x i' Mi' j Mj hd k as1 as2 e e' w w' _ _ HMi' HrvI Hvi HM Hm) as (cupsa & Hca & Hra).
    destruct (Hmot_x i' Mi' j bb ba w w' _ _ _ _ _ _ HMi' HrvI Hvi Hbb Hba Hm Hra Hrb) as (a & a' & Ea & Ea' & HR).
    rewrite motive_entries_combine in Ea, Ea'.
    exists Mi', a, a'; split; [ exact HMi' | split; [ exact HrvI | split; [| split; [| exact HR ] ] ] ].
    - eapply eval_elim_neut; [ exact Hq | exact HMi' | rewrite <- (view_member_ref _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb HrvI); exact Href | exact Hq'
                             | exact HMq | unfold im_np; lia | exact Hbb | rewrite (HnmB _ _ _ HMi' Hbb), Hnnq, Hnn'; reflexivity
                             | exact Hca | rewrite Hnuq; exact Ea ].
    - eapply eval_elim_neut; [ exact Hl | exact HM | exact Href | exact Hq' | exact HMq | unfold im_np; lia | exact Hba
                             | rewrite (valid_blocks_binder_count _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk _ _ _ HM Hba), Hnnq; reflexivity
                             | exact Hcb | rewrite Hnuq; exact Ea' ].
  Qed.

A stuck eliminator of each side at related neutrals, when the two read back alike: related at the family.
  Lemma cross_neut_elim : forall i' j Mj hd k as1 as2 e e' w w' ns ns', List.nth_error vm i' = Some j ->
      ind_member D j = Some Mj -> im_is_rview Mj = false ->
      G j w w' ns ns' (⇑ (d_ind hd k as1) e) (⇑ (d_ind hd k as2) e') ->
      Dom d_elim ρb VBb qc ub i' as1 e ≈ d_elim C1 Bks p u0 j as2 e' ∈ per_bot ->
      cross_member_results i' j w w' ns ns' (⇑ (d_ind hd k as1) e) (⇑ (d_ind hd k as2) e').
  Proof.
    pose proof (nparams_rel_sym p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI) as tsym.
    intros * Hvi HM Hrv Hcur Hb.
    pose proof Hcur as Hcur0.
    inversion Hcur0 as [| j0 Mj0 hd0 k0 ns0 ns0' as1' as2' e0 e0' w0 w0' HM0 Hrv0 Href Hn L1 L2 Hs1 Hs2 He |]; subst;
      [| rewrite HM in *; match goal with H : Some _ = Some _ |- _ => injection H as <- end;
         exfalso; eapply not_rview_record; eassumption ].
    rewrite HM in HM0; injection HM0 as <-.
    pose proof (ind_rel_idx p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hcur Hs1 Hs2) as Hm.
    destruct (cross_neut_values _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvi HM Hrv Hcur) as (Mi' & a & a' & HMi' & HrvI & Ea & Ea' & HR & Han & Hak).
    apply (cross_member_elim _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Mi' Mj _ _ HMi' HrvI HM Hrv Ea Ea').
    apply (self_motive_move _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hrv Hm (tsym _ _ HM _ _ Hs1) (tsym _ _ HM _ _ Hs2)).
    exact (per_bot_then_per_elem HR (per_bot_neutral_at _ _ _ Han Hak Hb)).
  Qed.

  Hypothesis (Hbot_x : forall i' j Mj hd k as1 as2 e e' w w' ns ns', List.nth_error vm i' = Some j ->
                ind_member D j = Some Mj -> im_is_rview Mj = false ->
                G j w w' ns ns' (⇑ (d_ind hd k as1) e) (⇑ (d_ind hd k as2) e') ->
                Dom d_elim ρb VBb qc ub i' as1 e ≈ d_elim C1 Bks p u0 j as2 e' ∈ per_bot).

Related Elements Eliminate to Related Values

  #[local] Abbreviation adm := (adm_uparams D u0 nr ar dr).

  Theorem cross_elim_all :
    (forall j u u' ns ns' x x', G j u u' ns ns' x x' -> adm u -> adm u' ->
       forall i', List.nth_error vm i' = Some j -> cross_member_results i' j u u' ns ns' x x') /\
    (forall k u u' pre pre' Ts gs vs vs',
       con_args_rel p D (admissible_index_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr k u u' pre pre' Ts gs vs vs' -> adm u -> adm u' ->
       forall gs', cargs_correspond vm gs' gs -> cross_args_vals k u u' pre pre' Ts gs' gs vs vs') /\
    (forall k u u' pre pre' Ts t x x',
       rec_arg_rel p D (admissible_index_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr k u u' pre pre' Ts t x x' -> adm u -> adm u' ->
       forall t', shape_correspond vm t' t -> cross_arg_vals k u u' pre pre' Ts t' t x x') /\
    (forall k u u' pre pre' Ts t f c f' c',
       rec_arg_app_rel p D (admissible_index_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr k u u' pre pre' Ts t f c f' c' -> adm u -> adm u' ->
       forall t', shape_correspond vm t' t -> cross_app_vals k u u' pre pre' Ts t' t f c f' c').
  Proof.
    pose proof (nparams_rel_sym p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI) as tsym.
    apply ind_rel_mut_ind_all.
    -
A constructor: the container's wrapped branch against the group's, moved to the indices.
      intros * HM Hrv Href Hn Hcn Lb Lb' Hs Hs' Ha Hia IH Hau Hau' i' Hvi.
      destruct (cross_member i' k Hvi) as (Mi' & Mk0 & HMi' & Hvmb).
      pose proof (view_member_mem _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as HMk0; rewrite HM in HMk0; injection HMk0 as <-.
      assert (HrvI : im_is_rview Mi' = false) by (rewrite <- (view_member_is_rview _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb); exact Hrv).
      destruct (view_member_cons' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb c gs Hcn) as (gs' & Hc' & Hcorr).
      destruct (IH Hau Hau' gs' Hcorr) as [w ihs Ew Ei Hcr].
      destruct (HbB _ _ HMi' HrvI) as [bb Hbb]; destruct (HBks _ _ HM Hrv) as [ba Hba].
      destruct (brs_names_lookup _ _ _ _ (HnaB _ _ _ HMi' Hbb) Hc') as (nb & Bb & HBb & HinB).
      destruct (brs_names_lookup _ _ _ _ (valid_blocks_names _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk _ _ _ HM Hba) Hcn) as (na & Ba & HBa & HinA).
      pose proof (HarB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMi' Hbb Hc' HinB) as Hnb.
      pose proof (valid_blocks_arity _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hba Hcn HinA) as Hna.
      destruct (self_ref_target _ _ _ _ HM Href) as (Dq & Mq & Hq' & HMq & Hnnq & Hnuq).
      destruct (con_args_rel_len _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hia) as [Lv Lv'].
      pose proof (cargs_correspond_len _ _ _ Hcorr) as Lgs.
      pose proof (view_member_nn _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as Hnn'.
      match goal with |- cross_member_results _ _ _ _ _ _ (d_con _ _ _ (?bs ++ ?vs)) (d_con _ _ _ (?bs' ++ ?vs')) =>
        assert (Hcur : G _ _ _ _ _ (d_con _ _ _ (bs ++ vs)) (d_con _ _ _ (bs' ++ vs')))
          by (eapply ind_rel_con; [ exact HM | exact Hrv | exact Href | exact Hn | exact Hcn | exact Lb | exact Lb' | exact Hs
                                 | exact Hs' | exact Ha | exact Hia ]) end.
      pose proof (ind_rel_idx p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hcur Hs Hs') as Hm.
The branches' variables read back at the types each eliminator stores them at: the container's by its own, the group's by the group's own recursive results (branch_entries_readable).
      pose proof (Hcbr_x i' Mi' k Mk c gs' gs u u' bs bs' vs vs' w ihs hd k'0 HMi' HrvI Hvi HM Hc' Hcn Hm Hcr) as Bc.
      destruct (proj1 (proj2 self_elim_all) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hia Hau Hau') as (ihsL & ihsR & EL & ER & HLR).
      assert (ihsR = ihs) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_ihs; eassumption).
      pose proof (nparams_rel_trans p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI _ _ HM _ _ _
                    (tsym _ _ HM _ _ Hs) (nparams_rel_trans p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI _ _ HM _ _ _ Hn Hs'))
        as Hss.
      destruct (XS branch_entries_readable _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hau Hau' HM Hcn Hss Ha Hia HLR) as [_ Bg].
      destruct (Hbr_x i' Mi' k Mk bb ba c gs' gs nb na Bb Ba u u' bs bs' vs vs' w ihs hd k'0 _ _ HMi' HrvI Hvi HM Hbb Hba Hc' Hcn HBb HBa
                  Hm Hcr Bc Bg) as (r & r' & Er & Er' & Hrr).
      rewrite branch_entries_combine in Er, Er'.
      apply (cross_member_elim _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Mi' Mk r r' HMi' HrvI HM Hrv).
      + eapply eval_elim_con; [ exact Hq | exact HMi' | rewrite <- (view_member_ref _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb HrvI); exact Href | exact Hq'
                              | exact HMq | exact Hc' | rewrite List.length_app; unfold im_np; lia | exact Hbb | exact HBb
                              | rewrite Hnnq, Hnn'; exact Hnb | exact HlcQ | |].
        * rewrite skipn_app_exact by (unfold im_np; lia); exact Ew.
        * rewrite firstn_app_exact, skipn_app_exact, Hnuq by (unfold im_np; lia); exact Er.
      + eapply eval_elim_con; [ exact Hl | exact HM | exact Href | exact Hq' | exact HMq | exact Hcn
                              | rewrite List.length_app; unfold im_np; lia | exact Hba | exact HBa | rewrite Hnnq; exact Hna
                              | exact Hlc | |].

        * rewrite firstn_app_exact, skipn_app_exact, Hnuq by (unfold im_np; lia); exact Er'.
      + apply (self_motive_move _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hrv Hm (tsym _ _ HM _ _ Hs) (tsym _ _ HM _ _ Hs')); exact Hrr.
    -
A neutral: both stuck, their readbacks agree.
      intros * HM Hrv Href Hn L1 L2 Hs1 Hs2 He _ _ i' Hvi.
      assert (Hcur : G k u u' ns ns' (⇑ (d_ind hd k'0 as1) m0) (⇑ (d_ind hd k'0 as2) m'))

                                 | exact He ]).
      exact (cross_neut_elim i' k Mk hd k'0 as1 as2 m0 m' u u' ns ns' Hvi HM Hrv Hcur
               (Hbot_x i' k Mk hd k'0 as1 as2 m0 m' u u' ns ns' Hvi HM Hrv Hcur)).

A record view: the container's is one of the same record and fields, its fields' results against the group's fields'.
      intros * HM Hhr Hnp Hcs Hp Hp' Ha Hia IH Hau Hau' i' Hvi.
      destruct (cross_member i' k Hvi) as (Mi' & Mk0 & HMi' & Hvmb).
      pose proof (view_member_mem _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as HMk0; rewrite HM in HMk0; injection HMk0 as <-.
      assert (HrvI : im_is_rview Mi' = true)
        by (rewrite <- (view_member_is_rview _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb); unfold im_is_rview; rewrite Hhr; reflexivity).
      unfold im_is_rview in HrvI; destruct (im_head Mi') as [| | qr' Is' fl'] eqn:Hh'; try discriminate HrvI.
      destruct (view_member_rview _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb _ _ _ Hh') as (Is2 & Hh2).
      rewrite Hhr in Hh2; injection Hh2 as <- <- <-.
      destruct (rview_struct_con _ _ _ (group_structure_record_struct _ HassQ) _ _ _ _ _ HMi' Hh') as (gs0 & Hcs' & _).
      destruct (view_member_cons' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb c gs ltac:(unfold ind_con; rewrite Hcs; cbn; rewrite String.eqb_refl; reflexivity))
        as (gs' & Hc' & Hcorr).
      unfold ind_con in Hc'; rewrite Hcs' in Hc'; cbn in Hc'.
      destruct (String.eqb c rview_con) eqn:Ec; [| discriminate Hc' ]; apply String.eqb_eq in Ec; subst c.
      injection Hc' as ->.
      destruct (IH Hau Hau' gs' Hcorr) as [w ihs Ew Ei Hcr].
      exact (cross_member_rview _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Mi' Mk qr Is' Is0 fl rview_con gs' rview_con gs vs vs' w ihs
               HMi' Hh' Hcs' HM Hhr Hcs Hp Hp' Ew Ei Hcr).
    - intros k0 u u' pre pre' Ts _ _ [| [rA' A' | t'] gs'] Hco; cbn in Hco; try contradiction;
      try (match type of Hco with _ = _ /\ cargs_correspond _ _ _ => destruct Hco as [_ Hco] end).
      exact (mk_cross_args_vals _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ nil nil ltac:(constructor) ltac:(constructor) ltac:(constructor)).
    - intros * Hia IH Hau Hau' [| [rA' A' | t'] gs'] Hco; cbn in Hco; try contradiction;
      try (match type of Hco with _ = _ /\ cargs_correspond _ _ _ => destruct Hco as [_ Hco] end).
      destruct (IH Hau Hau' gs' Hco) as [w ihs Ew Ei Hcr].
      exact (mk_cross_args_vals _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ w ihs ltac:(constructor; exact Ew) ltac:(constructor; exact Ei)
               ltac:(constructor; exact Hcr)).
    - intros * Hsh IHsh Hia IHia Hau Hau' [| [rA' A' | t'] gs'] Hco; cbn in Hco; try contradiction;
      try (match type of Hco with _ = _ /\ cargs_correspond _ _ _ => destruct Hco as [_ Hco] end).
      +
Nested through: the group's own results.
        destruct (IHia Hau Hau' gs' Hco) as [w ihs Ew Ei Hcr].
        destruct (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 self_elim_all)) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hsh Hau Hau') as (rs0 & rs & _ & Eh & _).
        exact (mk_cross_args_vals _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ w (rs ++ ihs) ltac:(constructor; exact Ew)
                 ltac:(econstructor; [ exact Eh | exact Ei ]) ltac:(econstructor; [ exact Eh | exact Hcr ])).
      + destruct Hco as (Hm & Hd & Hco).
        destruct (IHia Hau Hau' gs' Hco) as [w ihs Ew Ei Hcr].
        destruct (IHsh Hau Hau' t' (shape_correspond_of _ _ _ Hm Hd)) as [rs rs' Eh Eh' Hhh].
        refine (mk_cross_args_vals _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (rs ++ w) (rs' ++ ihs) ltac:(econstructor; [ exact Eh | exact Ew ])
                  ltac:(econstructor; [ exact Eh' | exact Ei ]) _).
        apply cross_fields_rec; [| | exact Hhh | exact Hcr ].
        * rewrite (proj1 (proj2 eval_ih_length_all) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Eh D' Hq HlcQ).
          symmetry; exact (leaves_in_count_view p qc D D' vm Hlc HlcQ (group_structure_record_struct _ Hass) (group_structure_record_struct _ HassQ)
                             cross_member (S (ptyp_mem t)) t' t 0 (fun _ _ _ => Nat.lt_succ_diag_r _) (shape_correspond_of _ _ _ Hm Hd)).
        * exact (proj1 (proj2 eval_ih_length_all) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Eh' D Hl Hlc).
    -
The end of a shape.
      intros * Hb Hb' Ok Ok' Hr IHr Hau Hau' [j' Ps' | B' t'] Hsc; cbn in Hsc; try contradiction.
      destruct (IHr Hau Hau' j' Hsc) as [Mi' Mj r r' HMi' HrvI HMj Hrv Er Er' Hrr
                              | Mi' Mj qr Is' Is0 fl c' gs' c gs ws ws' rs rs' HMi' Hh' Hcs' HMj Hh0 Hcs Ep Ep' Ei Ei' Hcr].
      + exact (mk_cross_arg_vals _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (r :: nil) (r' :: nil) ltac:(eapply eval_ih_self; eassumption)
                 ltac:(eapply eval_ih_self; eassumption)
                 ltac:(eapply cross_result_self; [ exact HMi' | exact HrvI | exact HMj | exact Hrv | exact Hb | exact Hb' | exact Hrr ])).
      + refine (mk_cross_arg_vals _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rs rs' _ _ _).
        * eapply eval_ih_rview; [ exact Hq | exact HMi' | exact Hh' | exact Hcs' | exact Ep | exact Ei ].
        * eapply eval_ih_rview; [ exact Hl | exact HMj | exact Hh0 | exact Hcs | exact Ep' | exact Ei' ].
        * eapply cross_result_rview; [ exact HMi' | exact Hh' | exact Hcs' | exact HMj | exact Hh0 | exact Hcs | exact Ep | exact Ep'
                                     | exact Hcr ].
